concerns.text: User‑Story 2 (Phase 4) depends on artifacts produced by US 1 (e.g., structural connectomes from T010 and cleaned EEG from T011b/c). This makes US 2 not independently shippable, violating the ‘independently‑shippable unit’ rule for each US block.

User‑Story 3 (Phase 5) consumes metrics generated in US 2 (e.g., metrics_combined.csv from T017) and thus cannot be executed in isolation, breaching the independent‑shippable requirement for US blocks.
Task T053 is tagged `[P]` but edits the same file (`report.py`) that T049 also edits. Parallel‑safe tags must not share mutable state; concurrent execution could cause race conditions on `report.py`.
